text:
sophia: Quick sync  we need a concise playbook for 'LaunchPad' tiers (startup-focused). Customers ask for simple tiers, pilot-friendly incentives, and clear no-unlimited-burst language. What do we ship for pilot vs GA?

jin: Tech reality: prioritize simple knobs. Recommend two tiers: LaunchPad Basic (1.8x) and LaunchPad Plus (2.6x + burst pool). Sample config: `{
  "tenant_hard_qps":2800,
  "tenant_soft_qps":5600,
  "burst_window_sec":600,
  "burst_tokens_month":100000
}`. Must include cluster policing and an admin clamp. Telemetry: lp.qps, lp.burst_used, lp.throttle_events.

oliver: Product suggestion: pricing examples for pilot only (simple numbers to show customers).
LaunchPad Basic: $1,200/mo + $0.10 per 1k tokens overage
LaunchPad Plus: $3,800/mo + $0.045 per 1k tokens, 100k burst tokens included
Pilot incentive: 30% off month 1 or 50k trial tokens. Keep GA decision after two pilots.

marco: Sales note: customers will push for unlimited bursts. Must have contract language rejecting that and a standard overage table. Non-negotiable: unlimited burst and SLA uplift without legal. Negotiable: included tokens, commit term.

emily-sales: I'll run outreach to three startup pilots (OrbitApps, BetaWave, PixelLabs). Sales playbook needs a one-pager listing negotiable levers and sample contract lines.

legal-bot: Clause ready: "Burst tokens allocate prioritized routing but do not guarantee absolute capacity; provider may throttle to preserve platform stability." Any SLA uplift requested must be escalated. Define token <-> compute-unit mapping in billing spec.

billing-bot: Reminder: new SKUs `launchpad.basic` and `launchpad.plus` needed; meter `lp.burst_tokens_used`. Tag pilot invoices with `pilot=true`. Support CU conversion table for mixed-model customers.

deploy-bot: Feature-flag `launchpad` toggled ON in staging for integration tests.

sophia: Launch criteria for pilot: 1) 2 pilots signed and invoiced, 2) console shows burst balance, 3) billing meter + invoice sample, 4) telemetry + 30d logs, 5) legal-approved clause, 6) runbook for cluster exhaustion. Target pilot kickoff in 3 weeks.

jin: Engineering caveat  simultaneous tenant bursts require cross-tenant fairness; will add emergency throttle and admin reclaim.

oliver: If no objections I'll finalize the pricing one-pager and hand to legal tomorrow.

marco: No objections. Sales will report progress by EOW.

sophia: Thanks team. Short follow-up Fri if needed.
